title: Case 07: Directives only — create a course (Vue 3)
titleZh: 案例07：只用指令创建课程（Vue 3）
summary: The same course page without the task layer. v-scope names regions, v-record publishes the draft, and v-tool declares one action per real control. The page starts on the catalogue; the agent clicks the real create button itself.
summaryZh: 同一张课程页面，不使用任务层。v-scope 命名区域，v-record 公开草稿，v-tool 为每个真实控件声明动作。页面初始停在课程库；助手自己点击真实的创建按钮。

guide.title: The same page with only three directives
guide.titleZh: 同一张页面，只靠三个指令
intro: This page declares no task, no form surface and no custom tools. The agent sees regions, read-only records and one action per existing control.
That is enough to create a course. The cost moves to the developer: every requirement and every allowed value has to be written into the action description.
introZh: 这个页面没有任务、没有表单 surface、也没有自定义工具。Agent 看到的是区域、只读记录，以及每个现有控件对应的一条动作。
这足以完成创建课程。代价转移到开发者身上：每条要求、每个可选值都要写进动作说明。

steps.title: Start from the real catalogue
steps.body: The dialog is closed on load. `new_course` is a real action on the real button, so the agent can open the form itself instead of receiving a page that is already half completed for it.
steps.bodyZh: 加载时弹窗是关闭的。`new_course` 绑定在真实按钮上，助手可以自己打开表单，而不是拿到一个已经被页面替它打开一半的界面。

steps.title: Name the form region
steps.body: v-scope groups the dialog and gives the agent a stable region id. It does not expose data or execution by itself.
steps.bodyZh: v-scope 把弹窗划成一个区域，并给 Agent 一个稳定的区域 id。它本身不暴露数据，也不提供执行能力。

steps.title: Publish the draft as a record
steps.body: The current form values, the required labels and the missing labels are a read-only v-record. The agent can answer “what is missing?” without a separate read tool.
steps.bodyZh: 当前表单值、必填标签和缺失标签组成一条只读 v-record。助手不需要单独的读取工具，就能回答“还差什么”。

steps.title: One action per control
steps.body: Each input, select and save button is declared with v-tool. The action targets the same native element a person uses; there is no selector language in the prompt.
steps.bodyZh: 每个输入框、下拉框和保存按钮都用 v-tool 声明。动作目标就是人使用的同一个原生元素，提示词里没有选择器语言。

steps.title: Describe the options by hand
steps.body: Directives do not read the teacher option list into a schema, so the description lists every allowed name and subject. Add a teacher to the page and this description has to change too.
steps.bodyZh: 指令不会把老师选项列表读成 schema，因此说明里必须列出每个可选姓名与方向。页面新增老师时，这段说明也要同步修改。

steps.title: Hand the upload to the person
steps.body: The cover action uses handoff. The agent can ask for it and point at the upload tile, but cannot choose a local file; completion is checked from the page state.
steps.bodyZh: 封面动作使用 handoff。Agent 可以提出请求并指向上传区域，但不能选择本地文件；完成与否从页面状态检查。

steps.title: Verify against the catalogue
steps.body: save_course runs the page's own handler and declares an expect check. The save is only successful when the new record is first in the catalogue.
steps.bodyZh: save_course 调用页面自己的保存处理，并声明 expect。只有新记录出现在课程库第一位，保存才算成功。

guide.note: Try the same request here and in Case 06. Both create the same record from the same page. Case 06 adds one goal so the outcome survives closing the dialog; this case keeps only the directives and has no task lifecycle.
guide.noteZh: 在案例06和这里试同一句话。两者都从同一张页面创建同一条课程记录。案例06多一个目标，让结果在弹窗关闭后继续存在；这里只保留指令，没有任务生命周期。
